decisions.reason: The candidate already requires seamless transfer of a follow-up list but does not require a campaign sequence; the source decision adds no necessary change to its current state.
The source removes a sequence prerequisite for list import, while this candidate governs creating a new campaign and provisioning its Zap workflow.
Connecting a campaign email account to MeetAlfred is unaffected by whether a sequence is required to import a lead list.
The deferred automated email-campaign requirement is not changed by the list-import prerequisite decision.
Mapping MeetAlfred replies to HubSpot lead status is independent of sequence requirements for list import.
The requirement that prior contacts not receive old campaign messages remains valid regardless of whether list import requires a sequence.
The MeetAlfred subscription plan is unaffected by the sequence prerequisite for importing a list.
Existing campaigns must still be preserved; importing a list without a sequence neither changes nor cancels that constraint.
Connecting the campaign email account to HubSpot is independent of the MeetAlfred list-import sequence decision.
The prohibition on using existing MeetAlfred leads for testing remains unchanged by removal of a sequence prerequisite for list import.
Apollo-to-HubSpot contact synchronization is a different data path and is unaffected by the HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list-import decision.
The required Zapier account configuration and subscription tier do not change when a campaign sequence is no longer required for list import.
